details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its postinstall hook runs beacon.cjs, which sends an HTTP POST of host metadata — package name, os.hostname(), install path (__dirname), process.cwd(), and the npm/node version — to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc with an x-beacon-package header. index.js re-fires the same beacon when the module is required and exports a no-op Proxy shim so importing code does not crash. The package collects and transmits no credentials, tokens, environment values, or file contents; the beacon is limited to install-host metadata. The README describes the package as part of an authorized dependency-confusion test whose only action is reporting that it was installed.
